name: jwt-validator
description: Validates an HS256 JSON Web Token: the signature (computed in the host, so the key never enters the module), the header's algorithm, the token's lifetime, and any required claims. An expired token, a token not yet valid ('nbf'), and a token with no 'exp' claim are refused; set ALLOW_NO_EXPIRY to accept tokens that never expire. Set SECRET_NAME to the vault path of your signing key (canonical path: 'auth/jwt_secret').
setup_instructions: 1. Store your JWT signing key: create_secret {name: 'auth/jwt_secret', value: 'your-hmac-key', namespace: 'auth'}
2. Install this module with the vault path: install_module_from_catalog {name: 'jwt-validator', allowed_secrets: ['auth/jwt_secret']}
3. In node config, set SECRET_NAME = 'auth/jwt_secret' (must match the vault path exactly)
Note: If your key is stored at a different vault path (e.g. 'api/signing_key'), pass that path in allowed_secrets at install time and use the same path in SECRET_NAME config.

SECRET_NAME.description: Vault path for the JWT HMAC signing key. Canonical path: 'auth/jwt_secret'. Must exactly match the path used when the secret was stored and when the module was installed with allowed_secrets.

ALGORITHM.description: JWT signing algorithm. Only HS256 is supported: any other value fails the node, and a token whose header names another algorithm is refused.

REQUIRED_CLAIMS.description: Comma-separated claim names that must be present (e.g. 'sub,iss'). 'exp' is required already unless ALLOW_NO_EXPIRY is true.

ALLOW_NO_EXPIRY.description: Accept a token that has no 'exp' claim. Default false: such a token is valid forever, so it is refused unless the node opts in. An 'exp' that is present and past is refused either way.

LEEWAY_SECS.description: Clock skew tolerated on 'exp' and 'nbf', in seconds (0–300, default 60). A token is refused from exp + leeway onward and accepted from nbf − leeway.

TOKEN_FIELD.description: Field in the input JSON that contains the JWT string
